how: Outside of the grey 12-sided cover, from one flat side to the flat directly opposite (not corner to corner). Calipers, or press two books against opposite flats and measure between them.
The small faceted box on the cover with the black cable. Width along the cover's edge; how far it sticks out past the cover's edge; front to back.
Clock position of the pod seen from the front (6 o'clock since 30 Sep), and how far its front face sits behind the cover's front face.
Hold a ruler flat on the chamber's left side (the door side) so it sticks forward. Measure across to the centre of the glass.
Tape from the floor straight up to the centre of the glass.
Straight up from the top of the cover to the first thing above it (the furnace's foot bracket), and how far back from the cover's front face that bracket starts.

what: Room to the left: door clamp
how: From the cover's left edge to the nearest point of the top-left star knob, knob tightened. Then loosen it and swing the bolt out: does it pass the cover, and by how much?
Across the hole in the cover's front face, at its front edge (the first edge you meet, not the glass), flat to flat.
Push the end of a steel rule (or the calipers' depth rod) straight in through the opening until it just touches the glass. Read it where it passes the cover's front face.
The clear glass you can see, edge to edge, across the middle.
Cover off: stand it face down on a table. Height from the table to its back edge. Then the inside diameter of the opening at its back (the part that slides over the nut) and how deep that goes.
The shiny round nut that holds the glass, across its outside.

what: Nut face, out from the chamber
how: From the flat steel front of the chamber out to the front face of the nut, square to the nut face. Measure at the nut's top and at its bottom (they differ if the port is tilted).
Hold your phone flat on the nut's front face with a level app (iPhone: Measure > Level). Write the degrees it leans back from vertical. Then do the same on the flat chamber face beside it.
Lay a rule horizontally across the nut's face. Measure from the chamber face to the rule at the nut's left and right edges. Same = it points straight out.

what: Cover face, out from the chamber
how: Cover back on: from the chamber face out to the cover's front face, at its top and at its bottom.
The shiny ring round the little window: across its outside, at the widest point. Calipers.

what: How far the ring sticks out
how: From the door's flat outer face to the ring's outer face.
Threaded nut with notches for a hook wrench, like the front port? Or a band clamp with a wing nut (KF)? Take one photo straight on and one from the side.
The clear glass, edge to edge.
Floor to the centre of the glass.
Horizontally to the door's back edge (the hinge side, nearer the blue cabinet), and up to the door's top edge.
From the bottom of the ring straight down to the top of the ultrasonic stack where it leaves the door.
Open the door fully: about how many degrees? Does anything on its outside come near the blue cabinet? Gap from the closed door's back edge to the blue panel.
Across the clear opening in the steel plate, left to right, inside edge to inside edge.
The same, top to bottom (along the slope).
The polished plate round the window: outside width at the top screw row.
Top edge to bottom edge of the plate, along the slope, through the middle.
Centre to centre of the top three screws, and the hex key size that fits them.
How far the glass sits below the plate's surface: rule end on the glass, read at the plate face.
Lay your phone flat on the window plate with a level app. Degrees from horizontal.
Floor to the centre of the window glass.
Wrap a tape round the round lower part of the lid. Write the circumference (we divide by 3.14).
Floor to the highest point of the closed lid.
The hinge on the lid's left: the pin's height above the floor, and how far left of the window's centre it is.
Tape round the silver furnace body (BLUE POWER lettering). Write the circumference.
Floor to the chamber's flat top, the deck the furnace stands on.
Floor to the top of the blue cabinet behind the furnace.
Does a magnet stick to its top? Front-to-back depth of the top, and what is up there. The top camera's magnetic base would stand on it.
The smallest gap from the back of the furnace body to the blue panel behind it.
Open the lid all the way. Floor to its highest point; how far left of the window's closed position its far edge reaches; and the angle it opened through.
